description: A rare deep-wild apex predator with a distinctive ambient-field property: field-illegible. Sensitive visitors notice the Feywood's ambient character becoming suddenly less readable in the stalker's direction. Thornroots take silverbough hart, Feywoodhorn stag, rootback elk, rare moonthorn wolves, and opportunistically humans and elves. Rare, deep-wild-only, genuinely dangerous.

ecology.cultural_role: deep-wild danger; field-illegible in its direction

name: Thornroot Stalker
